sections.heading: Decision record
sections.body: Completed October 6, 2026: bootstrap/self-funded; hard $5,000 proof-of-concept ceiling with itemized founder approval before spending; no warm industry network; U.S.-only cold-start discovery; founder-led validation before team recruitment or outside capital; U.S.-first commercial validation, with Florida potentially remaining the formation jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Authorization boundary
sections.body: The strategy decisions do not authorize formation filing, spending, outreach, fundraising, recruiting, or other external commitments.
